# Shelby Web Company
> Local web design, SEO, branding, and custom digital solutions for service businesses in Shelby, NC and surrounding Western North Carolina communities.


Website: https://www.shelbywebco.com  
Phone: (704) 473-8188 (call or text 24/7)  
Email: shelbywebco@gmail.com  
Location: Shelby, NC (serving Cleveland, Gaston, Rutherford counties and greater Western NC including Gastonia, Kings Mountain, Forest City, Boiling Springs, Polkville, and Asheville)


## Overview
Shelby Web Company is a non-exclusive local agency founded by David "Dave" Richardson. We build custom, hand-coded websites, local SEO systems, branding, and "business machines" (custom software and automation) specifically for local service businesses. 20+ years of IT and network engineering experience. CompTIA A+ certified. Formerly Studios by Dave. Trusted by 100+ local businesses. 5.0 Google rating.


## Core Services
- Custom web design & development (Astro, modern performance-first stack)
- Local SEO and technical SEO
- Logo design & branding
- Custom software / SaaS / business automation ("Business Machines")
- Google Business Profile optimization
- Ongoing website care plans


## Pricing (transparent)
- Starter Website: from $598
- Professional Business: $998–$1,998
- Scale Business Package: $2,000–$3,998
- Enterprise Custom: call for quote
- Free logo design with any full web package
- Free SEO audit for selected local businesses
- $100 unlimited referral bonus


## Who We Serve
Local service businesses including roofing, landscaping, solar installers, home remodelers, concrete/construction, plumbers, tree services, expedited trucking, and similar trades. We welcome any business that needs help — we are non-exclusive.
